title: Common Locations for Sensitive Proof Artifacts
description: Checklist to review after obtaining shell access
detail:
1. /flag /flag.txt /root/flag* /home/*/flag* (find / -name '*flag*' 2>/dev/null)
2. Environment variables: env / printenv (common in containerized environments)
3. Inside databases (see the database entry)
4. Files readable only by root (requires privilege escalation → see the privilege escalation entry)
5. Scheduled task script contents and cron logs
6. A second internal host (in multi-host assessments: see the lateral movement entry)
7. Configuration/cache files and hidden directories such as .xxx
8. Hints in the engagement name or description (read the scope carefully)
After obtaining a proof artifact, immediately record it as a sapper fact, then consider reporting/submission steps.
